title: TypeScript Beginner Mock Test 1
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for TypeScript at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes type inference in TypeScript?

options.text: the compiler derives a type from available expressions
reassigning an inferred string variable to a number is rejected
It changes the JavaScript runtime automatically
It requires a paid compiler plugin

questions.explanation: the compiler derives a type from available expressions. Confirm compiler behavior with strict mode and a minimal example instead of relying on an assertion.
